summary: Sizzle Acquisition Corp. II, a Cayman Islands blank-check company, filed an 8-K disclosing Amendment No. 1 to its April 13, 2026 Business Combination Agreement with Luxembourg-based Trasteel Holding S.A., Pubco Trasteel S.A. and Cayman Merger Sub. The amendment pushes the PCAOB audit delivery date from July 31 to September 30, 2026, fixes the post-closing Pubco board at five directors — one Sizzle II designee, four Company designees — and Sizzle II waived the five-business-day Pubco/Merger Sub formation joinder timing under Section 8.22. A Form F-4 proxy/prospectus is contemplated. Watch for further delay amendments and redemption levels as the deal clock extends.
